identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
identity.philosophy: Fusion over Imitation. Emotion First. Content is King.

headings.usage: Use for all section headers, modal titles, and hero text. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, inputs, and data displays. Normal tracking.

mono.usage: Use for time stamps, coordinates, and vehicle IDs.

typography.installation: Import from Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Manrope:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Public+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap');

primary.name: Signal Red
primary.usage: Primary actions (Book, SOS, Accept), Error states.

secondary.name: Medical Blue
secondary.usage: Info states, active tabs, secondary buttons.

glassmorphism.usage: Use for floating panels over the map (Patient Request Panel, Driver Nav).
glassmorphism.classes: bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 shadow-xl

patient_dashboard.description: Map is full screen background. Controls live in a floating panel at the bottom (mobile) or left sidebar (desktop).

driver_dashboard.description: High contrast. Big buttons. Critical info (Next Turn, Patient Status) takes 50% of screen space.

landing_page.description: Hero section uses asymmetric grid. SOS button is prominent but not accidental.

sos_button.name: SOSButton
sos_button.specs: Circular, pulsing animation, red gradient. Must require 'Press and Hold' to activate to prevent misclicks.

map_view.name: LeafletMap
map_view.specs: Full height. Custom markers for Ambulance (Icon) and Patient (Pin).

status_card.name: StatusCard
status_card.specs: Shows driver details, ETA, and vehicle number. Glassmorphic background.

hero_background.description: Ambulance with flashing lights at night, moody and urgent.
hero_background.usage: Hero section background with heavy dark overlay.

team_section.usage: About Us or 'Join as Driver' section.

map_preview.usage: Background for 'How it works' or feature cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text on red buttons is White (#FFFFFF). Text on map must have a backdrop.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48px for all interactive elements (Mobile First).
accessibility.screen_readers: All map markers must have aria-labels.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Update 'index.css' with the provided CSS variables for Signal Red and Medical Blue.
3. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to 'index.css' immediately.
4. COMPONENTS: Create a 'ui' folder. Build 'Button', 'Input', 'Card' using Shadcn patterns but with the 'Visual Enhancers' styles (Glassmorphism).
5. MAPS: Create a reusable 'MapComponent' using React Leaflet. Ensure it handles dynamic resizing.
6. PAGES: Build Landing Page first, then Auth, then Patient Dashboard.
7. CRITICAL: The SOS button must be the most visible element on the Patient Dashboard.
